## Leg 5 — per-check isolation re-run + two defect families found+fixed

The full-tree suite death (leg 4, jetsam kill at ~29 Gi compressed, exit 137)
is bounded *within* a check by `ba89427b` but accumulates *across* the 15
checks — `verify-percheck-driver.py` runs each check in a fresh subprocess
and writes `S-<cid>` row files (the `D-P37.65a-8` kill-isolation evidence
leg). Per-check suite launched 2026-11-27 ~14:15Z; results so far:
V1 fail → V3 pass → V4 fail → V5 in flight, V6-V15 queued.

- **D-P37.65a-9 (check-side machinery)**: V1's first 20 unresolved links
  were the P35.39 `<link rel="describedby">` →
  `releases/<pub>/datapackage.json` — an activation-overlay route
  `_emit_activation_metadata` writes only at `release activate`, after the
  activation-time crawl gate (a catch-22). Fixes: `9f4eb626`
  (`EXTERNAL_LINK_PATTERNS` in `release_pages.py` + fullmatch in
  `_route_is_external_or_denied` + regression test) and `86774080`
  (V4/V5 read the stamp pair + chrome scope; `_ACTIVATION_OVERLAY_*`
  exempt in S-mode only — the D-P35.56-1 deny-gate defect stays loud in
  P-mode; fixture emits the real stamp pair + post-activation tree).
- **D-P37.65a-10 (emit-side, s/ dist bytes)**: V1's post-fix re-run still
  `incomplete` — the s/ pages mis-based shared-namespace links:
  `withBase()` non-idempotent → 88 already-based `path=` props emitted
  `/s/<pub>/s/<pub>/…` canonicals + og:urls (also V4's ~1.15M stamp/header
  violations); `releases/` + `r/` links base-joined though they stage at
  root; four raw `href={artifactHref(…)}` relative links. Fix `3ba21906`:
  `withBase()` idempotent on already-based paths, `Figure.astro` routes
  `/`-prefixed hrefs through `dataHref()` (OUTSIDE-base root-absolute),
  the record-list target `/r/…`, `releases/` links `rootPath()`'d, raw
  `artifactHref` sites `withBase()`'d, three path-containment baseline
  allow-list entries. DEFERRALS rows -9 + -10 registered `584c8ea7`.
  Owed: s/-dist rebuild → restage → V1/V4/V5 re-run. Open sub-question:
  `provenance.jsonld` ships at the export-bundle root but lands nowhere
  in the release tree — dead target on both bases, needs its own route
  decision.
- s/ rebuild attempted on the fixed tree (`run-dists.sh s`,
  `SIG_BASE_PATH=/s/p-31371dfb…`, outDir `/tmp/sig-web-dists-out/snapshot`)
  — **aborted at ~8 min** (astro pid 78206 killed): the volume had only
  ~4.5 Gi free after deleting the two stale dists (~200 Mi each — they were
  APFS-clone-shared with `work/`), and the build had already consumed
  ~2.3 Gi with ~20 min to go; an ENOSPC mid-suite would risk corrupting
  the in-flight V6 row's evidence. Required sequence once the per-check
  suite completes: `rm -rf work/s/<pub>/` (registry already holds those
  bytes) → rebuild s/ dist (~10 Gi headroom) → copy the dist into
  `work/s/<pub>/` (`cp -Rc` clone-share) → stage-reconcile plan+apply →
  `release stage --apply` → re-run V1/V4/V5 (+ any V6-V15 row that read
  the s/ bytes).
